forum.title: Error: No STM32 target found! If your product embeds Debug Authentication, please perform a discovery using Debug Authentication
forum.best_answer_content:
Hello ​@Kushal2707,

The product you are using is a clone of a genuine ST product.

To get the support you need, please contact the third party you purchased this product from.

For assurance of buying authentic ST products, we recommend purchasing exclusively through our official distributors, which you can find listed here:[ST Official Distributors](https://www.st.com/content/st_com/en/contact-us.html).

Best regards,

Maxime

forum.author: Kushal2707

scraped_replies.html:
I am using STM32F411CEU6 Black Pill 

Note that this is not an ST product, and might not contain a genuine STM32

 

 I am using stlink clone

Unsurprisingly, ST tools are not guaranteed to work properly - or even at all - with fake or cloned ST-Links.

Have you tried with a genuine ST-Link, or other known-good debug probe?
scraped_replies.author: Andrew Neil

scraped_replies.html:
The STM32F411CEU6 is probably genuine by ST.

+

Try connect in mode: normal + software reset.

(As the sticks/clones have no working hardware reset !!! )

scraped_replies.author: Kushal2707

scraped_replies.html:
I was able to flash the device with the clone stlink 3 hours ago but now I am not able to do it. 

 

So what did you change in those 3 hours?

In particular, have you added low-power and/or reconfigured the SWD pins.

Intermittent working could be a sign of poor wiring connections - please show some good, clear photos of your setup.

 

what about the usb dfu method? I’m getting download failed error

Has that method ever worked for you ?
scraped_replies.author: Andrew Neil

scraped_replies.html:
All I did was note down the readings from the pins(A0,A1,A2,A3,A4) I had configured using multimeter. I made sure I didn't touch neighbouring pins.

 

I didn't try with usb dfu before since this is a new board which I bought yesterday since I was able to flash with stlink I just continued with it. When stlink failed I tried the dfu method but even that failed.
